newsitem.title: JAPAN: LME prices steady in quiet Asia, seen rangebound.
newsitem.headline: LME prices steady in quiet Asia, seen rangebound.

text.p: London Metal Exchange prices were steady during quiet Asian trading hours and were expected to continue the rangebound trade of recent sessions as the Easter holidays draw near, traders said.
Japanese traders and end-users were also said to be maintaining a low profile as they prepare to close their books at the end of the fiscal year on March 31.
One trader noted that aluminium found good support during Tuesday's dip to the $1,640 a tonne level, although the upside appeared to be capped by producer selling around $1,680 to $1,690.
At 0750 GMT, LME benchmark three-month copper was quoted at $2,387/92 a tonne, little changed from $2,386/89 at 1900 GMT on Tuesday. Copper ended the Tuesday afternoon kerb at $2,377.
Aluminium was quoted at $1,656/60 a tonne, up slightly from $1,653 at the close of Tuesday's afternoon kerb.
Nickel was quoted at $7,780/800, little changed from the Tuesday kerb close of $7,780.
